mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate activity (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 40% of instances when HOUST is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when INDPRO MoM < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS MoM > 0% and UNRATE MoM < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances when RSAFS YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 QoQ < 0% during a monetary tightening cycle.
